Kabir is a ten-year-old South Asian boy with a slender build, warm brown skin, and short cropped black hair. His face features dark eyes and a straight nose. He wears a #3F7D4E green bomber jacket over a #F2E8CF off-white tee, paired with tan cargo shorts and gray sneakers. A canvas satchel covered in colorful embroidered patches hangs across his chest. In his hands, he holds a wooden folding ruler with brass joints. At rest, he stands with his weight shifted slightly forward, his fingers resting on the brass joints of his folded ruler.
